manifest.method: For each tokenizer and pair, len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)); equal pair mean per tokenizer; headline = maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable), lo/hi = tokenizer span. Comparator: complete-careful-English stating full completeness semantics (mid tier). CHALLENGE: existing rows (b1ac5573 +2.5, bdab60c8 +2.5) use minimal-diff unhyphenated glosses, pricing hyphenation (+2.5) not the completeness distinction; full-meaning comparator flips the sign. File all finite outcomes once without tuning.
